[u]Statements on the Coup in Dhornaper and Coup Attempt in Baladullah[/u]

[i]بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم [/i]

Supreme Commander Musa al-Yahudiyya of the Armed Forces of Baladullah:

Brothers, we have a sworn duty to our country and more importantly, to Allah: to defend the country and uphold justice, internal security, and order in accordance with the Constitution. I understand the temptation to take power, thinking that your military experience also equates to political knowledge. But these kinds of things often end badly. One who takes power in a coup is often removed in another coup, dead or alive.
